# larp

> Bash utilities that aggregate GitHub repo contributors across an account and write git commits under a chosen identity's noreply email.

larp is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/larp/blob/HEAD/README.md): install, usage and reference
- [Requirements](https://github.com/nirholas/larp/blob/HEAD/README.md#requirements)
- [fetch-contributors.sh](https://github.com/nirholas/larp/blob/HEAD/README.md#fetch-contributorssh)
- [commit-push.sh](https://github.com/nirholas/larp/blob/HEAD/README.md#commit-pushsh)
- [run-all.sh](https://github.com/nirholas/larp/blob/HEAD/README.md#run-allsh)
- [License](https://github.com/nirholas/larp/blob/HEAD/README.md#license)
- [Documentation](https://github.com/nirholas/larp/blob/HEAD/README.md#documentation)
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/larp/blob/HEAD/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
- [Full text for LLMs](https://github.com/nirholas/larp/blob/HEAD/llms-full.txt): the README inlined
